brand_notes: M126Be is the top PerformaBe-series standmount (beryllium tweeter), above Performa3 M106; launched 2019 at $4,000/pair, now $2,200 each at Audio Advice with some finishes sold out. Revel US site (revelspeakers.com) still lists it. Revel product page returned HTTP 410 to scripted fetch. Harman-style wide, smooth directivity (sources eac-revel-m126be, audioholics-revel-m126be).
takeaways: EAC Klippel: LW ±1.1 dB, sens 85.7 dB, pref 5.1/7.3, f6 50 Hz (f3 93 Hz artifact of bass shelf)
Min impedance 4.9 Ω (EAC), ~4.5 Ω (NRC) on 8 Ω nominal: below-iec but not 4-ohm; EPDR 3 Ω
EAC compression: no ≥3 dB through 102 dB @1 m; THD ~1.7% @100 Hz at 86 dB, ~4.2% at 96 dB (graph-read)
Four critic reviews all positive (neutral, imaging, smooth Be treble); bass depth is the common caveat
Price now $4,400/pair, above 2019 MSRP, with scarce stock
conflicts: f3 93 Hz computed inconsistent with f6 50 Hz and Audioholics knee near 60 Hz
Stock/status thin: some finishes sold out
